test_origin_selection: five evenly spaced feasible forecast starts inside the held-out test interval, inclusive of earliest and latest feasible starts
test_model_policy: fit once on train+validation for each dataset x horizon x model x seed; keep model fixed across all test origins
later_origin_inputs: earlier observed test values may enter only as past history at later forecast origins; no test-period refitting
table1_summary: average seeds within each rolling origin, then mean +/- SD across five temporal origins
table3_comparison: unit-free paired percentage change matched by dataset x horizon x origin x seed; descriptive only
ablast_transformer_block: seeded fixed sequence-aware attention/Transformer feature transformation; not gradient-trained
hyperparameter_policy: ridge lambda selected on validation only; architecture fixed a priori
